post.caption:
The evidence at Giza is a workers' village: bakeries, breweries, cattle bone for thousands of meals a day, and worker tombs built in sight of the monument itself. Skeletons show fractures that were set properly and healed, meaning injured workers were treated and fed while unable to work. The gangs even left graffiti with team names. The ramp question is genuinely unresolved. The workforce question is not.
